title: Zesty Sweet Japanese Rice Bowl
description: A sweet and gooey Japanese dish featuring the taste of orange zest, perfect for kids. This ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly recipe is a great breakfast or snack option.

ingredients.name: Orange Zest
ingredients.notes: Grate 1 orange for 2 tablespoons of zest.

ingredients.name: Coconut Sugar
ingredients.notes: Use a mild sugar for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Coconut Oil
ingredients.notes: Ghee or other non-stick oil also works.

ingredients.name: Sea Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a light hand with this.

instructions: Combine rice, water, and sesame seeds (if using) in a medium saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 15 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
In a small saucepan, melt the coconut oil over low heat.
Add the coconut sugar and sea salt. Stir until the sugar dissolves.
Add the orange marmalade and stir until well combined.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the mixture thickens slightly.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of Japanese rice in each bowl.
Spoon the orange marmalade mixture over the rice.
Garnish with orange zest, sesame seeds, and orange wedges (if using).
